item.title: Iran’s China envoy vows ‘special’ Hormuz treatment for ‘friendly’ countries
item.description: Despite US objections, ambassador insists new fees to be charged to vessels transiting Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: This immigrant served in the US military. Now he faces deportation
item.description: Benito Miranda Hernandez completed three tours during the Iraq war but now faces removal from the US to Mexico.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
item.description: Ali Khamenei's son Mojtaba is conspicuously absent from his father's funeral on Sunday, amid speculation about his condition.

item.title: Large crowds gather in Tehran on first day of Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral
item.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla until Monday, before travelling across Iran and Iraq.

item.title: France records 2,025 excess deaths at peak of heatwave as Europe braces for more extreme weather
item.description: Forecasters are warning of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.

item.title: Funeral of Iran's former supreme leader 'intensely political moment'
item.description: Authorities expect up to 20 million people to attend ceremonies across Iran and Iraq over the coming days.

item.title: BBC in Tehran as mourners gather for former supreme leader's funeral
item.description: Iranian authorities say they expect millions of people to take part in funeral commemorations for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
